metadata.source: OWASP Testing Guide, Public Bug Bounty Methodology, Our Synthesis
metadata.provenance: Synthesized from OWASP Testing Guide and public bug bounty methodology, our own words

description: Reconnaissance is read-only, low-risk asset discovery: subdomains, endpoints, tech fingerprint, auth surface. Never active payloads.

tools: subfinder (if installed), amass (if installed), crt.sh via web_search, DNS brute force with caution
techniques: Check certificate transparency logs via web_search (crt.sh)
Check DNS records (A, CNAME, MX, TXT)
Brute force with small wordlist, rate limit 200ms, stop if no new after 2 iterations
subdomain_enum.evidence: List of subdomains with source (crt.sh, DNS, brute force), tool output
subdomain_enum.scope_enforcement: Only authorized domains, respect rate limits, stop if endless recon

endpoint_discovery.description: Discover endpoints, API routes, hidden paths
tools: web_search for docs, browser for spidering, terminal with curl, ffuf/gobuster if installed (with approval)
techniques: Spider web app via browser (navigate, snapshot)
Check JS files for API endpoints, hardcoded paths
Brute force with small wordlist only if authorized and rate limited
endpoint_discovery.evidence: List of endpoints with method, discovered via (spider, JS, docs, brute force), tool output
endpoint_discovery.scope_enforcement: Only authorized domains, read-only GETs, no active brute force without approval

tech_fingerprint.description: Identify tech stack: server, framework, JS libraries, etc.
tools: wappalyzer via browser, headers via curl, web_search for tech detection
techniques: Check HTML meta, JS libraries (React, Angular, etc.)
Check for framework-specific paths (e.g., /wp-admin for WordPress)
Check for API tech: REST, GraphQL, gRPC
tech_fingerprint.evidence: Tech stack list with version if available, source (header, HTML, JS), tool output

auth_surface.description: Map authentication flows: login, registration, password reset, session, JWT, OAuth, etc.
tools: browser for auth flows, curl for API auth, web_search for auth methodology
techniques: Check for login, registration, password reset pages
Check for JWT: decode (no verification) to see claims
Check for OAuth: authorization code flow, implicit flow
Check for session: cookie, localStorage, etc.
Map auth flows for later auth testing
auth_surface.evidence: Auth flows list with endpoints, method, tech (JWT, OAuth, session), tool output

rate_limiting: 200ms between active requests per host by default, don't bypass without operator approval
anti_loop: Detect endless recon: if no new assets after 2 iterations, stop recon and move to attack surface modeling
output: Asset inventory: subdomains, endpoints, tech fingerprint, auth surface, with evidence and tool output references
